scope: Headless GUT shutdown after all project tests. Raw counts include Godot-held global script classes; they may only be recalibrated after an audited pinned GF vendor-tree or project runtime class-set change, and must not grow while both inputs remain unchanged.
calibration_reason: Ten audited runtime script classes raise the project class set from 214 to 224: five local-player-profile classes for account identity, change data, catalog transactions, system coordination, and profile UI; and five tile-lab classes for blueprints, save data, simulation results, system coordination, and route UI. The complete suite expands from 50/409 to 57/451 scripts/tests. This recalibration changes only the declared project class-set count and suite description; the existing ObjectDB, Resource, and RID ceilings remain unchanged and continue to be enforced by the safe GUT runner.
